tools.name: price_parts
tools.description: Use for a new CAD file (STEP or DXF): its binding offer and, paid, its result; to follow a purchase use get_result, for a paid part at another lot size use preview_cost. Costs EUR 0.89 per made part per environment, VAT included, no account; bought and catalogue parts free; billable only when paid,

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Use to follow a purchase price_parts made: its status while it runs, then its result and receipt, and what it still owes, if anything; for a new file use price_parts, for a paid part at another lot size use preview_cost. Needs the purchase_id and result_token the paid answer carried. Answers: status
